note: U-pick berry farm with five electric RV spots at the front, among tent sites; water spigot about 15 ft from the RV sites, gray-water dump only ($10). Farm play park and splash area for a per-person fee. --Claude
summary: Hipcamp (live, 98% of 217) + operator page: 5 electric RV spots (to 50A) of 16 sites, $8-25 host price plus Hipcamp fee, no sewer/black dump, solar showers; Google 4.8 (53). Rate under the $50 gate; passes inclusion and the long-stay tests.
flags: FEES: the $8 low is real - Hipcamp's 'Pullin On Over' is a plain $8 pull-over spot (60 ft) with electric extra ($3 Hipcamp fee on top). The farm's own page posts higher, undated prices ($25-26 RV, $29 for 50A); recorded the live Hipcamp prices as the base and noted the page's.

PRESENCE/PRICE: own website https://bberryfarms.com/park-info + phone 417-933-2046 (same on Google and the site footer); live Hipcamp instant-book; Google 4.8 from 53 reviews, Hipcamp 98% of 217. Passes.

LONG-STAY: only 'Extended stays now offered from November 1 to march 1' and an A-frame that 'can be rented long-term'. All 16 sites sell single nights on Hipcamp (1-night minimum), no application or lease, not a home community, price under $50 - passes all five tests. I did not run a two-weeknight calendar check (weak spot, low risk).

INCLUSION: a farm campground, but real - 5 electric RV spots, posted rig lengths to 60 ft, showers, phone and its own booking channel. One negative Aug 2026 Hipcamp review (ticks, dirty restroom) among 217; no drop signal.
HOOKUPS: water left unknown - Hipcamp tags 'Water hookup' on one RV site, but the operator's page says 'Water hookup is 15' away'.
PIN 37.4447,-93.0058 matches Google (37.44470,-93.00585). Waterfront not waterfront stands; the 'swimming hole' is a walk-in feature in the back forest.
